description:
Ask Canva to create on-brand social posts, presentations, marketing materials, or other visual assets based on your current conversation, then continue editing together in the chat.

Try prompts like this:
· Can you turn this image into a fully editable design, @Canva?
· @Canva, create some social posts based on our recent campaign brief – remember to add our Brand Kit!
· @Canva, resize these posts for different channels
· I need my latest design translating into Spanish please @Canva!

Want to take a more hands-on approach? Instantly open your design in Canva’s powerful editor for the final touches.

defaultPrompt: create some social media posts based on our October campaign brief
use these latest investor meeting notes to make a Q1 2026 pitch deck
can you resize this poster as an Instagram post for my online store?
